---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem using synthetic or public data
---

## What happened

Describe the observed and expected behaviour.

## Reproduction

Include a small runnable example with synthetic data and the complete error message.
Do not include patient data, credentials or private file paths. For security vulnerabilities,
use the private reporting route in SECURITY.md instead.

## Environment

Include your OS, Python version and versions of spc-lib-py, pandas, NumPy and Pydantic.
For rendering problems, include the Plotly version.
